root_cause: Production original powerhouse_runtime_scheduler_mux_v1 dispatches original data-spine-watchdog at m%10=1 (six times/hour). It records genuine source health, observation and provider readback, but original powerhouse_refresh_regression_stage_evidence_v1 records action, outcome, learning and guard only at minute 23 and 53 (twice/hour). Assurance source contract expects 10-minute cadence and expires stages after 20 minutes. Therefore every interim natural run yields AMBER with up to five missing stages despite 0 unhealthy sources, destroying cross-agent live feedback accuracy.
fix: Preserve original public.powerhouse_data_spine_watchdog_v1 and source-proven per-source event loop, append original loop assurance action/outcome/learning/guard receipt write immediately after successful real watchdog reconciliation with same p_now and exact unhealthy count. Mark metadata explicit customer_outcome_verified=false, causal_learning_verified=false; guard pass only if gaps=0; no additional scheduler, data table or service access.

Preserve original business-boundary semantics and follow up natural original #171 minute m%10=1 then original 15-loop assurance; read actual stage observed_at and verify status. Never synthetically backfill or overwrite user/provider metrics.

invariants: no fake growth, customer conversion or causal learning

valid source time and exact 10-min expected cadence
no new publisher, scheduler, table or view
migration source lock same protected PR
